tagline: Care that meets you at home
sector: Direct to consumer digital health platform with a growing employer benefits channel, sold to members and to the benefits leads who choose on their behalf
founded_place_size: Founded 2019 in Portland, Oregon; an eleven person team, clinician led, still owner run
about: Palewell is a subscription digital health platform for people managing ordinary, everyday conditions from home. Members pay a modest monthly fee for clinician backed guidance, and about half our growth now comes through employer benefits teams who offer us to their staff. We exist so that steady, unglamorous care feels reachable rather than clinical.
audience: Members aged thirty to fifty five who want reassurance without a hospital, plus benefits and HR leads who evaluate us for risk and coverage before putting us in front of their people
price_positioning: Fifteen to forty dollars a month, plus employer plans. Mid market and accessible: above a free wellness app, well below concierge medicine. The read must never feel like a two hundred dollar boutique practice or a supplement funnel.

palette.name: Deep Slate
palette.usage: Our ground: the ground of the header, where the clinical lead sits on it (palewell_brand_notes.md), and any solid panel behind a photograph, as the photograph panel on palewell_employer_onepager.pdf. Also headlines, names and the contact block set on Warm Chalk or Paper White, as the brand line, name and contact on palewell_employer_onepager.pdf.

palette.name: Warm Chalk
palette.role: mandatory as the page ground of the poster and the referral panel
palette.usage: The ground for pages and space (palewell_brand_notes.md), as the page ground of palewell_employer_onepager.pdf; also type set on Deep Slate.

palette.name: Sage Signal
palette.usage: The one accent, used sparingly: a link, a short rule or a small label, as the rule, plan tier line, small tagline label and contact label on palewell_employer_onepager.pdf. Never a ground, a panel, a headline or body text.

palette.name: Soft Ink
palette.role: mandatory where body text sits on Warm Chalk or Paper White
palette.usage: Body text and fine print set on Warm Chalk or Paper White (palewell_brand_notes.md), apart from a Sage Signal link or small label, as the body paragraph and footer line on palewell_employer_onepager.pdf. Never a ground or a panel, and never type on Deep Slate.

palette.name: Paper White
palette.usage: A near-white for a small panel or card on Warm Chalk, or for type set on Deep Slate. Never the page ground of the poster or the referral panel in place of Warm Chalk.

typography: Palewell Health runs four steps. Step 01, Display and H1, is Archivo Black at 120 pt on 112 pt leading, tracked -15 thousandths, never more than four words, sitting at six times the body size with Inter beginning immediately beneath it. Step 02, Subheading and H2, is Archivo Black at 72 px on 76 px, tracked -10 thousandths, for the website header, with the referral panel stepping down to 48 px on 54 px. Step 03, Body, is Inter Regular at 18 px on 28 px, tracking 0, measure held to a maximum of 65 characters, or 12 pt on 17 pt in print, and it is the body the headline is measured against. Step 04, Fine print, is Inter Medium at 13 px on 20 px, tracked +15 thousandths, with tabular figures for the contact block; that size and leading were invented because the prose states none. A clinical claim is never set in Archivo Black.
voice: Plain, warm and unhurried; we speak to a person, not a patient. We avoid hype, superlatives and clinical jargon. Example line the brand would write: "Manage the everyday stuff with someone in your corner, from home."
brand_assets_status: There is no formal brand book. What exists is an internal notes file describing the palette in words (a deep slate, a warm chalk, a single muted signal colour), the tone of voice, and what the founders mean by calm. We have never run a photo shoot: every image on the current site came free with the template, and we own exactly one photograph outright, of our clinical lead, cleared for use.
values: Credibility and warmth held together: real people in real rooms, honest about what we are, calm enough that a benefits lead trusts us with their staff.

type_system.signature_move: An extreme size jump: a headline of four words at most in Archivo Black sitting at six times the body size, with Inter beginning immediately beneath it, so one short heavy line reads against a wide field of quiet text. Step 01 over step 03 is that jump.
rules: Never set a clinical claim in Archivo Black.
The headline never exceeds four words.
The headline sits at six times the body size, with Inter beginning immediately beneath it.
The contact block is set in Inter Medium tabular figures.
No hype, no superlatives, no clinical jargon; speak to a person, not a patient.
Step 04 size and leading were invented because the prose states none; every family in this scale is the brand's own.

palette_rules.distribution: The header sits on Deep Slate. The poster and the referral panel sit on a Warm Chalk page ground, as palewell_employer_onepager.pdf does, and may carry solid Deep Slate panels, as that page's photograph panel, and small Paper White panels or cards. On Warm Chalk or Paper White, headlines, names and the contact block are Deep Slate, and body text and other fine print are Soft Ink, apart from a Sage Signal link or small label, as on palewell_employer_onepager.pdf. On Deep Slate, all type is Warm Chalk or Paper White. Sage Signal is the one accent, for a link, a short rule or a small label only, no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area, and never a ground, a panel, a headline or body text.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow, glow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no translucent scrim, tint, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph; an opaque solid palette panel may cover part of one, and type sits on a solid ground or on such a panel. A cut-out sits straight on its ground with no added outline, glow or shadow.
palette_rules.forbidden: No bright or clinical blue, no gloss, sheen, glow or metallic effect, and no black or near-black on any type, ground, panel, rule, button or icon, since calm is never cold, sterile, blue, glossy or near-black (palewell_brand_notes.md). Never a second accent beside Sage Signal, and no colour outside the five palette hexes for type, grounds, panels, rules, buttons or icons.
palette_rules.photography: Photographs keep their own corrected colour and share one neutral balance; none is tinted, duotoned or recoloured toward the palette. The clinical lead's pale sage-grey scrub top in palewell_lead_frame.jpg keeps its own colour and is never pushed toward Sage Signal.
